change: Herald: a realm's boss arrives announced, its name across the screen and a line of its own mathematics

mutations.name: the herald for every foe
mutations.find: on(B){ return !!(B && B.mode==='campaign' && B.foe && B.foe.boss && this.SAY[B.foe.nm]); },

mutations.name: the herald outside the campaign
mutations.find: on(B){ return !!(B && B.mode==='campaign' && B.foe && B.foe.boss && this.SAY[B.foe.nm]); },

mutations.name: the banner in the wrong colour
a boss with no line
mutations.find: 'The Unbounded':          'it swears it grows without end',

mutations.name: two bosses announced alike
mutations.find: 'The Gradient Itself':    'the way up, from wherever you stand'
mutations.replace: 'The Gradient Itself':    'it swears it grows without end'

mutations.name: the herald never called
mutations.find: Herald.announce(this);   // a realm's boss arrives announced

mutations.name: the herald never called, seen in play
mutations.find: Herald.announce(this);   // a realm's boss arrives announced

mutations.name: the herald for every foe, seen in play
mutations.find: on(B){ return !!(B && B.mode==='campaign' && B.foe && B.foe.boss && this.SAY[B.foe.nm]); },
mutations.replace: on(B){ return !!(B && B.mode==='campaign' && B.foe && this.SAY[B.foe.nm] || B && B.foe); },
